verdict: A quiet day: mostly research-paper noise and entertainment press releases, with one real pipeline-relevant item (World Creator 4) and one legitimate industry-practice story (Epic's AI-first mandate) worth a glance.

stories.headline: World Creator 4 terrain generator adds full-planet generation
stories.body: BiteTheBytes released World Creator 4, a major update to its terrain generation tool, adding the ability to build complete planets alongside its existing large-scale terrain workflows. CG Channel reports new features and a release date but full technical specifics (licensing, DCC integration, pricing) weren't detailed in this report. Worth checking the vendor page if terrain/world-building is part of your environment pipeline.
stories.why: A terrain tool upgrade could affect environment generation workflows feeding Houdini or USD pipelines.

stories.headline: Epic Games reportedly tells staff to go 'AI-first', delays unannounced shooter
stories.body: Epic Games has told developers to adopt an 'AI-first' production model covering both code and artwork, and reportedly delayed an unannounced Marvel/Star Wars shooter as a result, according to 80 Level. Details on tooling, scope, or which AI systems are involved aren't specified. This is a studio-direction story, not a tool release, and the claims are unverified beyond the single report.
stories.why: Signals how a major studio may restructure production roles around AI, worth watching for pipeline precedent.
